title: Machine-learning aortic calcification scores are linked to falls and fractures
summary: An automated ML algorithm (ML-AAC24) scored abdominal aortic calcification on DXA spine images in 1023 women (mean age 75) followed up to 14.5 years. Moderate-to-extensive calcification (score at least 2) carried higher risk of clinical fracture (HR 1.42, 95% CI 1.10-1.85) and fall-related hospitalization (HR 1.35, 95% CI 1.09-1.66) after adjusting for baseline fracture risk.
ai_technology: Automated machine-learning algorithm scoring abdominal aortic calcification on DXA images

evidence.tested: Association analysis in a prospective cohort using existing images.
evidence.unknown: Association only; ML provides the measurement, not the prediction of outcomes; full text not reviewed.
